personas.name: Solo Freelance Makeup Artist
personas.short_description: Books bridal and event clients over WhatsApp, invoices advances and balances, and tracks overdue payments and 90-day cash for rent and kit restocks.
key_responsibilities: Create invoices in 3 taps with client name, event date, total fee, and advance paid
Track pending balances and mark payments as received
Generate one-click polite WhatsApp payment reminders ready to copy and send
View the Who Owes Me dashboard of overdue clients, amounts, and days overdue
Review the 30/60/90 day cash forecast and run the late-bridal-payment what-if toggle
frictions: Chasing advance and balance payments by hand across WhatsApp threads after bridal events
Losing track of which clients still owe money once several bookings overlap
Lumpy event income makes it hard to know if next month's rent and kit restocks are covered
instructions: Make invoice creation a three-step flow with large tap targets and sensible defaults for event date and advance
Put the Who Owes Me list on the home screen, sorted by days overdue, with one-tap access to the reminder
Show the reminder text in a copy-ready card with a single copy button and no extra confirmation step
Surface action alerts at the top of the home screen in plain sentences with the exact amount and due date
